note: SRA on a chain of six sandpit lakes (52 acres of water in all) 3 mi S of Elm Creek, just off I-80 near Kearney: non-pad sites with picnic tables and grills spread along the gravel park roads among the pits, hand-pump hydrant, vault latrines, boat ramps; electric-motor and non-powered boats only. No dump station (a camper reports the nearest at Fort Kearny, ~20 min). --Claude
summary: Still NGPC (Active SRA, on the 2025 rates grid). Sites 30 / electric 0 / FCFS confirmed from NGPC's page (Aug 2026 capture); season year_round and facilities (hydrant, vault latrines) added; max_rig_ft 50 cleared (directory only). Fees left. Waterfront lakefront -> lakeview proposed (sites can't be placed at the water). No pin move, no sand problem.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview (down, per the 'unsure after every source' rule). The stored value rests only on the June 2026 sweep's bucket ('set by that satellite/per-site-map sweep'), with no per-site detail; NGPC's map draws no sites and its page says only '30 non-pad sites'. I could not place any RV site at a shoreline: NAIP shows gravel loop roads skirting the pits (open grass and cottonwoods between road and water in most places) and no parked RVs; Overpass was down. Lakes on a NIR water mask: northern pits ~29.5 ac connected, others 7.2, 6.1, 5.9, 4.9 ac and many ponds under 1.5 ac (the stored pin is 12 m from the 4.9-ac pit, a pond under the 5-acre line). A view holds: the roads run beside several 6-30 ac pits and NGPC's own photo is captioned 'Waterside tent camping at Sandy Channel'. LEAD: lakefront back only with a dated photo of an RV site at the water's edge of one of the 5-ac+ pits.

SAND: not a sand-driving campground. The sites are along gravel park roads on grass among trees; the only sand is a small swim-beach patch at the NE pit ('Unkempt beach area for swimming', Google review). No drop.

PIN not moved: stored 40.66848,-99.37802 is the junction of the entrance road inside the park, central to the road network; sites are not mapped, so no centroid. Google's point (40.66843,-99.38015) is the US-183 entrance, 180 m west.

WEBSITE: second line https://visitnebraska.com/kearney/sandy-channel-state-recreation-area is a tourism listing; NGPC's https://outdoornebraska.gov/location/sandy-channel/ is the operator page, so the visitnebraska line can go (apply.py doesn't write website). PHONE 308-865-5305 confirmed (NGPC page, 2025 grid, Google).

NOTE: dropped 'Reported max RV length 50 ft' (directory, now cleared), 'FCFS, primitive' and 'basic sites' wording (fields; NGPC says non-pad sites), 'some at the water's edge' (not stated by NGPC and not visible), and 'Park entry permit required' (fees.entrance carries it). Google 4.4 from 16.
